title: Giziga, North | Ethnologue Free
text: North Giziga is a stable indigenous language of Cameroon. It belongs to the Afro-Asiatic language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.

title: South Giziga language
text: South Giziga is a Chadic language of the Afro-Asiatic family spoken by approximately 60,000 people primarily in the Far North Region of Cameroon.
